name: COMO Cocoa Island, The Maldives
insider_take: This adults-only overwater paradise sits on a pristine coral island shaped like a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, offering unparalleled access to one of the world's most biodiverse house reefs.
whats_special: COMO Cocoa Island features just 34 overwater suites built in traditional dhoni style, each with direct lagoon access. The resort is renowned for its world-class COMO Shambhala Retreat spa treatments and exceptional house reef that attracts marine life including reef sharks, rays, and over 100 fish species just steps from your villa.
pro_tip: Book snorkeling gear upon arrival - the house reef is best explored during high tide in the early morning when visibility is crystal clear and marine activity peaks.
dont_miss: The sunset dolphin cruise to spot spinner dolphins in their natural habitat, and the signature COMO Shambhala Asian-inspired spa treatments performed over the lagoon. The resort's house reef is considered one of the Maldives' finest for snorkeling directly from your villa.
pros: Overwater villas with direct lagoon access
Intimate boutique resort with personalized service
cons: Remote island location requires seaplane transfer
Limited dining options on small island
